span_convention: half-open offsets; char offsets count Unicode code points; byte offsets count UTF-8 bytes; token offsets index frozen BPE tokens

annotation_types.entity_type: Entity name or type word with entity_id.
annotation_types.property_mention: Property key and value phrase with entity_id.
annotation_types.property_value: Property value span and typed value with entity_id.
annotation_types.relationship_phrase: Relation phrase with source_id and target_id.
annotation_types.relationship_type: Relation type span with source_id and target_id.
annotation_types.action_mention: Action phrase with structured action payload.
annotation_types.action_type: Action phrase classified by action type.
annotation_types.action_validity: Action phrase labeled valid or invalid from oracle result.
annotation_types.precondition: Rendered rule phrase linked to an action type.
annotation_types.state_change: Rendered state-change sentence grounded in before/after state.
annotation_types.state_change_entity: Mention of an entity changed between states.
annotation_types.invalid_action: Invalid action outcome labeled with oracle reason code.
annotation_types.violated_constraint: Constraint name or explanation grounded in oracle result.

overlap_policy: Distinct annotations may overlap in character, byte, or token space. Preserve each sidecar annotation; token objective channels reject conflicting labels within one task.
